name: The tummy tuck procedure has evolved and improved since the procedure was first tried in 1899.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: The standard technique, which has been with us for about 30 years, consists of a horizontal incision in the lower abdomen.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: This is still a fairly standard technique in most plastic surgery practices. It has a couple of problems that make this method rather risky.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: First, there may be insufficient blood getting to the lower central skin after the procedure and this can result in an area of dead skin which can create a hole.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: The second is that there is a large space under this flap that needs prolonged drainage tubes and often drainage fluid will accumulate there after the drains have been removed.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: I have been doing a better technique recently which seems to have solved these problems.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: The results have been amazingly good.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: If you are extremely thin and you do not need the liposuction we can omit it and do the rest of the new and improved technique.

name: A tummy tuck is also known as an abdominoplasty. It is one of the most common cosmetic procedures performed in my practice.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: Loose skin and stretch marks often develop after pregnancies.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: Often this is cosmetically unacceptable, but every patient is different. Your particular problem will be examined and evaluated individually. I will customize the procedure for you.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: Although the anatomy of the abdominal wall is quite complicated it can be broken down to three distinct layers - muscle, fat and skin.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: If it is fat only, then liposuction might be appropriate. Liposuction will not tighten skin or muscles.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: With liposuction I make small punctures - usually three. I inject some clear IV fluid containing epinephrine.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: I treat the skin with ultrasound applied to the skin surface.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: I suction using the syringe liposuction method where there is no machine. The vacuum of the syringe provides all the suction power that is needed.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: When performed for the right Modesto / Stockton liposuction patient, this procedure can produce outstanding aesthetic results.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: If you have a moderate or small amount of fat and and also a limited amount of loose skin a mini abdominoplasty might be the right choice.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: However, for some people whose extra skin is confined to below the belly button and whose upper abdominal skin does not need correction
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: With a mini abdominoplasty recovery is quick, and no drains are required. It also costs less.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: However, most people do not fall into this category because the fat and extra skin and stretch marks are spread out throughout the whole abdomen
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: Recently the full tummy tuck and been significantly improved. The results are much better than they were before, and recovery is quicker.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: All our tummy tucks are done as an outpatient. You go home the same day.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: In order to explain the new technique and new improvements I would like to comment on the old technique first.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: The muscles may have spread apart due to pregnancy.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: The skin and fat is now stretched downwards and the excess is trimmed off at the level of the original incision.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: The fat under the skin that remains has not been removed.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: There is a large potential space where two large surfaces can rub together. This space needs to be drained and this space can cause problems.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: There is a risk of skin dying just above the pubic area resulting in delayed healing or a hole that needs prolonged dressing care.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: Over the past several years we have done a lot to improve the technique and get around these problems.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: Now we do liposuction of the entire abdomen to remove the excess fat.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: Then we lift the skin and the lower abdominal tissue to the level of the belly button, but not as high as before.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: We create a tunnel upwards from the belly button to the upper abdomen so that we can tighten the muscles from the top to the bottom at the pubic area.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: What we do not do is to elevate the skin to the ribs on both sides.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS

name: So now the procedure is safer with much better healing, and better blood flow to the skin above the pubic area.
location.name: John S Silverton, MD, FRCS
